text:
jess: Heads up — planning to enable venturi-14b in the model catalog tonight. Staggered cutover: EU -> NA, canary first (5% traffic), then linear increase over 1h. Need final pinlist and fallback ordering before we hit the change window. @deploy-bot can you lock the change-window for 23:00 UTC?

deploy-bot: scheduled change-window created by jess at 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z (window: 2h). Canary: 5% on dedicated pool eu-west1. Notification: #eng-releases, #eng-oncall.

omar: quick Q — are we enabling quantized variants (int4) in the canary or only float? latency profile differs.

jess: canary will use venturi-14b-quant-v1 (int8) for initial test, fallback ladder will include venturi-14b-fp and then baseline-comet13b if we need to degrade.

anita: Guardrails: p95 latency increase > 25% OR error rate > 0.5% for 5m => auto rollback. Also require no model-level safety alerts in the first 30m. Add smoke eval set in Canary.

micah: drop a rollout config snippet so infra can sanity-check.

jess: ```
# rollout config
model: "venturi-14b"
variant_canary: "venturi-14b-quant-v1"
canary_traffic: 0.05
stages:
  - duration: 10m
    target: 0.05
  - duration: 50m
    linear_to: 1.0
fallback_order:
  - "venturi-14b-fp-v1"
  - "venturi-14b-quant-v0"
  - "comet-13b-stable"
pins:
  - region: "eu-west1"
    version: "venturi-v1.02"
  - region: "us-central1"
    version: "venturi-v1.02"
```

sre-bot: Runbooks linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollout. SLO dashboards: /dashboards/venturi-14b. I'll create a temporary alert with the thresholds Anita listed.

anita: Also add canary telemetry hooks: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, rate-limited count, and avg tokens-per-request. If any drift in output quality (eval set failure) -> manual hold.

omar: For pinlist: confirm we pin venturi-v1.02 across both regions; if a quick rollback needed we should be able to pin back to comet-13b-stable in <5m.

micah: Ops checks done. Network quotas verified. Can we add an explicit manual rollback command alias? e.g. `/rollback-model venturi 0 -> comet-13b-stable`

jess: yes, ops approved. I'll create the pin list and trigger the canary at 23:05 UTC. Reminder: keep the canary to 5% for at least 15m.

deploy-bot: canary enable initiated by jess at 2469012400. Status: rolling out to 5% canary (eu-west1 dedicated pool).

deploy-bot: canary hit 5% at 2469012460 — health checks passing (latency: p95 +8%, errors 0.06%).

micah: collecting logs and metrics now. smoke-eval started (20 queries).

sre-bot: smoke-eval: 18/20 pass, 2/20 flagged for minor tokenization variance, no safety flags. p95 steady but watching.

anita: good to proceed to linear increase if p95 stays within 15% and error <=0.1%.

deploy-bot: increasing traffic to 25% at 2469012500 per stage.

deploy-bot: 25% reached — observed p95 +22% vs baseline, error rate 0.12%. Alert: p95 close to threshold.

omar: seeing a subset of gen paths with longer sequences causing kv-cache spillovers. Might be workload-dependent.

jess: decision: pause ramp and hold at 25% while we investigate. If we can't narrow down within 15m, we'll rollback. @anita please confirm.

anita: confirmed. Hold and scope. Create issue with query patterns, adding tokens-per-request histogram.

micah: reproduced locally for a long-context path; patch candidate: reduce max_batch_window for venturi-quant to avoid oversized batches. Can ship config change rapidly.

jess: let's attempt config patch in canary: reduce batching and retry. If improvement within 10m, continue.

deploy-bot: applying canary config patch at 2469012540: set max_batch_window_ms=20 for venturi-14b-quant-v1.

deploy-bot: patch applied. Observed p95 drop to +12% and error rate to 0.08% at 2469012560.

anita: looks good. Resume ramp to 60% over 20m. Keep auto-rollback thresholds unchanged.

deploy-bot: resuming ramp, target 60% over 20m.

deploy-bot: 60% reached at 2469012580. Health checks: p95 +14%, error rate 0.09%.

jess: proceed to full enable over next 30m but keep strict monitoring. Notify CS about possible minor latency change for low-impact apps.

deploy-bot: 100% enable completed at 2469012600. Post-deploy metrics: p95 +16%, errors 0.10%.

sre-bot: post-deploy smoke eval: 20/20 pass. No safety alerts.

anita: initial telemetry looks within guardrails. Keep enhanced monitoring for 6h.

micah: note: small subset of long-sequence customers might still experience higher latencies; we should prepare a targeted rollback pin if needed.

jess: filing follow-up doc and release notes now. Thanks all for quick responses.

-- 2h later --

deploy-bot: alert: p95 drift trending upward for one cohort (high-token requests) — +28% sustained over 10m at 2469016000. Triggering oncall notification.

jess: decision: initiate rollback to comet-13b-stable for affected traffic lanes. Rolling rollback now.

deploy-bot: rollback executed: venturi-14b disabled for flagged lanes; overall traffic now 92% venturi / 8% comet-13b-stable pinned for those lanes.

omar: investigating root cause with perf traces. Will follow up with perf diff report.

anita: logging postmortem stub and will assign owners for mitigation: better dynamic batching heuristics and improved long-context preflight.

jess: outcome: cutover partially successful but we rolled back targeted lanes due to long-sequence latency. Plan: refine batching and run another canary with revised workload filters tomorrow morning. Scheduling follow-up change-window. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
